name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single high-contrast skip link at the top of every page. It’s the fastest way to let keyboard users bypass repetitive navigation blocks and reach main content without tabbing through dozens of links. The trade-off is a tiny bit of extra layout space, but that’s negligible compared to the barrier it removes for people who rely on keyboards.

name: Reader
text: The real risk is sighted keyboard users missing the skip link entirely if it’s hidden behind a high-contrast overlay. A better alternative is a visible skip link that appears on focus, like a subtle underline or background shift, so users see it only when needed. Settle it by testing with 3 keyboard users—if they miss it, revert to a persistent visible link.
